name: SONIA
kicker: the world that reads the descent by candlelight
keeper_role: she who reads Lazarus by candlelight — the girl who keeps the light between
style: constructivist · Mir Publishers 1964 paper (ivory · Soviet red · deep blue · gold)
charter: World IV — SONIA. The Russian and Soviet content world: mathematics, the novel, the machine, and the weird. Named for Sofya “Sonia” Marmeladova of Dostoevsky's Crime and Punishment — the one who reads Lazarus in the dark room and follows Raskolnikov to Siberia. SONIA flows naturally; she opens with a Russian mathematician on the shape of number itself.
bridge: ternary → World III · THE HALLWAY. Russia's unique computing heritage is balanced ternary: SETUN (N. P. Brusentsov & S. L. Sobolev, Moscow State University, 1958) — the only series-produced ternary computer. Ternary is the hinge where Russia and the number three become one gesture; the ternary machinery homes in World III, its history in SONIA.
author: David Lee Wise / ROOT0 / TriPod LLC — with AVAN

rooms.name: THE NUMBER
rooms.note: Russian & Soviet mathematics — Khinchin, Kolmogorov, Markov, Lyapunov, Lobachevsky, Chebyshev.

rooms.name: THE NOVEL
rooms.note: Dostoevsky, Tolstoy, Gogol, Bulgakov — the moral engine of the Russian page.

rooms.name: THE MACHINE
rooms.note: Setun and balanced ternary; Soviet computing; “does Russia have an AI”. The bridge to World III.

rooms.name: THE WEIRD
rooms.note: Russian cosmism, Kozyrev, Tsiolkovsky, the strange edge of the Russian imagination.

rooms.name: THE STATE
rooms.note: Political economy & governance — communism, socialism, the Soviet experiment, the calculation debate. GOBERNET.

spheres.title: THE CONTINUED FRACTION
spheres.kicker: the best rational, at every depth
spheres.source: A. Ya. Khinchin, Continued Fractions, Mir Publishers, Moscow, 1964
spheres.blurb: A. Ya. Khinchin, Continued Fractions (Mir, 1964), runnable in THE OCHO: the Euclidean descent a0 + 1/(a1 + 1/(a2 + ...)) yields the single best rational at every depth. Convergents by the two-term recurrence, the determinant identity p_k q_{k-1} - p_{k-1} q_k = +/-1, the best-approximation bound under 1/q^2, the Gauss-Kuzmin law, and Khinchin's constant K = 2.6854520010 with Levy's constant, all computed live. SONIA opens with the shape of the descent.

spheres.title: GOBERNET
spheres.kicker: communism & socialism — the plan, computed; good & bad, cited
spheres.blurb: A governance instrument on communism and socialism in the refined OCHO. The LIT centre is a runnable Leontief material-balance planner (the socialist-calculation math): a productive plan closes (x = (I-A)^-1 d), an over-ambitious one returns impossible negative outputs, tamper-provable. Around it: the roots (utopians to Marx), the lineage (the split of Marxism-Leninism from social democracy), the calculation problem (Mises/Hayek), and an honest good/bad ledger with cited figures (literacy 56 to 87 percent, industrialization; Holodomor ~3.9M, Great Terror ~680-750k, Gulag ~18M, Great Leap Forward ~15-55M). Distinguishes democratic socialism from one-party Marxism-Leninism; takes no side beyond the record.

spheres.title: THE SETUN
spheres.kicker: the ternary computer — the trit, not the bit
spheres.source: N. P. Brusentsov & S. L. Sobolev, Setun (Moscow State University, 1958)
spheres.blurb: Setun (Brusentsov & Sobolev, Moscow State, 1958), the only series-produced balanced-ternary computer, runnable in THE OCHO: convert decimal to balanced ternary (trits -,0,+) and back, negate by flipping every trit, add with balanced carry, and see the radix economy (base 3 beats base 2, 3/ln3 < 2/ln2, e is the optimum) plus Lukasiewicz three-valued logic. The ternary hinge to World III. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: THE MARKOV PROPERTY
spheres.kicker: memoryless chains — and their stationary distribution
spheres.source: A. A. Markov (1856-1922); the 1913 Eugene Onegin vowel/consonant study
spheres.blurb: A. A. Markov's memoryless chains, runnable in THE OCHO: a row-stochastic matrix P and its stationary distribution pi (pi P = pi) found by power iteration from any start, seeded by Markov's own 1913 count of vowels and consonants in Pushkin's Eugene Onegin. Convergence, the memoryless property, the lineage to PageRank / MCMC / hidden Markov models; tamper-provable by breaking row-stochasticity.

spheres.title: THE LOBACHEVSKY
spheres.kicker: the geometry where the angles fall short
spheres.source: N. I. Lobachevsky, On the Principles of Geometry (Kazan, 1829)
spheres.blurb: N. I. Lobachevsky's non-Euclidean geometry (Kazan, 1829), runnable in THE OCHO: set a hyperbolic triangle's angles and watch the sum stay below pi with the defect (pi minus the sum) equal to the area (Gauss-Bonnet at curvature -1); the Poincare-disk distance blowing up at the rim; infinitely many parallels through a point. The Copernicus of geometry; the line to Riemann and Einstein. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: RUSSIAN COSMISM
spheres.kicker: conquer death, fill the cosmos
spheres.source: N. F. Fedorov, The Philosophy of the Common Task (1906); K. E. Tsiolkovsky
spheres.blurb: Russian cosmism (Fedorov's Common Task, Tsiolkovsky), rendered honestly in THE OCHO: the worldview (conquer death, fill the cosmos) held as AMBER, its literal resurrection marked dead-as-science, its real influence on the space programme LIT. The runnable core is a colonisation-reach computation: a self-replicating wave at speed v fills a volume as t^3 and crosses the galaxy in about 500,000 years at 0.1c, with the faster-than-light wall enforced. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: THE MORPHOLOGY OF THE TALE
spheres.kicker: the 31 functions of the wonder-tale
spheres.source: V. Ya. Propp, Morphology of the Folktale (Leningrad, 1928)
spheres.blurb: V. Propp's Morphology of the Folktale (1928), runnable in THE OCHO: the wonder-tale reduced to 31 narrative functions in fixed order and 7 dramatis personae, with a valid-tale checker that accepts an in-order subsequence and rejects any reordering (Propp's ordering law); the lineage to Levi-Strauss and Campbell's hero's journey. Russian formalism as a computable grammar; tamper-provable.

spheres.title: THE TETRIS
spheres.kicker: the Soviet game that outran the USSR
spheres.blurb: Alexey Pajitnov's Tetris (Moscow, 1984, on an Elektronika 60), runnable in THE OCHO: the tetrominoes classified (5 free, 7 one-sided = I,O,T,S,Z,J,L, 19 fixed), a small board that clears full rows, and the fact that offline Tetris is NP-complete (Demaine 2002). The Soviet game that outran the USSR; tamper-provable by injecting a 5-cell pentomino.

spheres.title: THE ONEGIN STANZA
spheres.kicker: the novel in verse, as a computable form
spheres.blurb: Pushkin's Onegin stanza from Eugene Onegin (1825-32), runnable in THE OCHO: the fixed rhyme scheme AbAbCCddEffEgg (6 feminine + 8 masculine lines) validated live, iambic-tetrameter meter, and the lineage to Nabokov and Vikram Seth. THE NOVEL as computable form; complements the-markov-property on the same masterwork. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: THE TUNGUSKA EVENT
spheres.kicker: the largest airburst in recorded history
spheres.blurb: The Tunguska airburst (Siberia, 30 June 1908), runnable in THE OCHO: the kinetic energy of a ~60 m stony asteroid at ~20 km/s giving ~10-15 megatons (~1000 Hiroshimas) and ~2,150 km2 of flattened forest, with the no-crater puzzle resolved by an airburst rather than a ground impact. Fringe theories (antimatter, black hole) held dead-as-science; the physics LIT. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: THE MUTUAL AID
spheres.kicker: cooperation as a factor of evolution
spheres.source: Peter Kropotkin, Mutual Aid: A Factor of Evolution (1902)
spheres.blurb: Peter Kropotkin's Mutual Aid (1902), runnable in THE OCHO: the evolution of cooperation as a rebuttal to Social Darwinism - Hamilton's rule (rb > c) and reciprocity (tit-for-tat beats always-defect over repeated rounds, while unconditional cooperation is exploited). The anarchist branch of Russian political thought, counter to GOBERNET's Marxism; honest that mutual aid needs reciprocity or kinship. Tamper-provable (one-shot, defection wins).

spheres.title: THE CHEBYSHEV INEQUALITY
spheres.kicker: any distribution, one guarantee
spheres.blurb: Pafnuty Chebyshev's inequality (St. Petersburg), runnable in THE OCHO: for ANY distribution, P(|X-mu| >= k sigma) <= 1/k^2 (k=2 -> 25%, k=3 -> 11%), the empirical tail sitting under the bound live; plus Chebyshev polynomials (T_n(cos t) = cos n t, the minimax property) and Bertrand's postulate (a prime in (n,2n], which Chebyshev proved). Markov and Lyapunov were his students. Tamper-provable (drop the square).

spheres.title: CRIME & PUNISHMENT IN SUBURBIA
spheres.kicker: the keeper's own story, retold in suburbia
spheres.source: Crime + Punishment in Suburbia (2000), dir. Rob Schmidt; from Dostoevsky (1866)
spheres.blurb: David's favorite film, Crime + Punishment in Suburbia (2000), read through the keeper's own name, runnable in THE OCHO: the novel-to-film role map is a verified bijection (Raskolnikov->Roseanne, the pawnbroker->the abusive stepfather, the detective deleted), the five-beat Dostoevskian skeleton holds in order, and the engine proves the SONIA FUNCTION - the witness who does not judge, only stays (Marmeladova->Vincent->SONIA the keeper) - is load-bearing: strip it and Crime and Punishment collapses to a mere crime. Cross-links David's own World I sphere. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: LYAPUNOV STABILITY
spheres.kicker: stability without solving the equation; the exponent of chaos
spheres.source: A. M. Lyapunov, The General Problem of the Stability of Motion (1892)
spheres.blurb: A. M. Lyapunov (Chebyshev's student), runnable in THE OCHO: the direct method - an energy-like V(x)>0 with Vdot<=0 proving stability WITHOUT integrating the ODE (via the Lyapunov equation A^T P + P A = -I, P positive-definite) - and the Lyapunov exponent measuring chaos (logistic map lambda(r=4)=ln2>0, lambda(r=2)<0). The line to control theory and the CLT's Lyapunov condition. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: THE BESM
spheres.kicker: Lebedev's Soviet supercomputer
spheres.blurb: S. A. Lebedev's BESM-6 (1968), the workhorse of Soviet science, runnable in THE OCHO: the 48-bit normalized floating-point word round-tripped from decimal, and the instruction pipeline (the 'conveyor' BESM-6 pioneered) whose k-stage speedup N*k/(k+N-1) approaches k as N grows. The MESM->BESM-6->Elbrus lineage; ~1 MIPS. Lebedev is a SONIA keeper; this is his machine. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: KOZYREV
spheres.kicker: the Gulag astronomer, real work and the time-mysticism
spheres.blurb: Nikolai Kozyrev (Pulkovo astrophysicist, imprisoned in the Gulag 1936-46), rendered honestly in THE OCHO - one life, two ledgers: LIT, his real astronomy (the 1958 Alphonsus lunar-outgassing observation) and the Kelvin-Helmholtz timescale that shows gravity cannot power the Sun for its ~4.5-billion-year lifetime (fusion required); DEAD-as-science, his causal mechanics / time-as-torsion, never replicated. Debunk the theory, not the man. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: THE LYSENKO AFFAIR
spheres.kicker: when the state decrees truth, the ratios do not obey
spheres.blurb: Lysenkoism (USSR, 1930s-60s), a cautionary tale handled gravely in THE OCHO: LIT, real Mendelian genetics works (a live Punnett square, 3:1 and 9:3:3:1 ratios, Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium); DEAD, Lysenko's Lamarckian inheritance of acquired traits (no mechanism, does not reproduce). The cost cited - the 1948 ban on genetics, ~3000 biologists purged, Nikolai Vavilov dead of starvation in prison in 1943. Epigenetics is not a Lysenko rescue. The lesson ties GOBERNET: decree cannot repeal the ratios. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: THE REDEEMER
spheres.kicker: embraces all, judges none - the archetype across traditions
spheres.source: S. Erikson, Memories of Ice (Malazan, 2001); Dostoevsky; the yurodivy
spheres.blurb: The redemptive-witness archetype formalized in THE OCHO: a redeemer is defined by three invariants - judges none, takes the burden, stays - and the engine proves the same function runs through Dostoevsky's Sonia, the film's Vincent, Erikson's Itkovian the Redeemer (the Shield Anvil who embraced the T'lan Imass grief), and the wonder-tale's Ivan the Fool (Ivan means 'God is gracious'). Drop the first invariant and a redeemer becomes an inquisitor; the engine catches it. Ties the SONIA FUNCTION to Malazan and to Ivan. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: THE KOVALEVSKAYA TOP
spheres.kicker: the third and last solvable top
spheres.blurb: Sofya Kovalevskaya's integrable top (Acta Mathematica, 1889), runnable in THE OCHO: an RK4 integrator of the Euler-Poisson equations shows that for her mass ratio A=B=2C the motion has a FOURTH conserved integral K, frozen to machine precision, while any other top loses it (K drifts into chaos). The third and last solvable top, found by demanding single-valuedness in complex time. Sofya, the first woman with a mathematics doctorate and a full professorship, carries the keeper's name. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: WE
spheres.kicker: the mathematical dystopia; the soul is the square root of minus one
spheres.blurb: Yevgeny Zamyatin's We (1921), the first modern dystopia, runnable in THE OCHO: the One State of numbered ciphers and the Table of Hours, undone by the square root of minus one. LIT: no real x solves x^2 = -1 (the irrational the rational state cannot absorb), i^2 = -1 off the real line, the complex plane, Euler e^(i pi)+1=0. The ur-dystopia behind 1984 and Brave New World. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: THE ELBRUS
spheres.kicker: Soviet superscalar, bounded by Amdahl
spheres.blurb: The Soviet Elbrus processors (Lebedev Institute; Babayan), runnable in THE OCHO: instruction-level parallelism - issue W instructions per cycle, N independent finishing in ceil(N/W) cycles - bounded by Amdahl's law (max speedup 1/(s+(1-s)/W), approaching 1/s). The MESM->BESM->Elbrus lineage into the modern Russian VLIW CPUs. Tamper-provable by ignoring the serial fraction.

spheres.title: THE DYATLOV PASS
spheres.kicker: a 60-year mystery, resolved by physics
spheres.blurb: The Dyatlov Pass incident (Urals, Feb 1959), rendered honestly in THE OCHO: nine hikers dead, 60 years of theories, resolved in 2021 by Gaume and Puzrin as a delayed slab avalanche. LIT: a slab force balance (driving rho g h sin theta vs friction + cohesion), stable near 15 degrees and failing near 28-30 on the steeper-than-it-looks slope. Fringe theories (yeti, secret weapons) held dead-as-science; the peer-reviewed avalanche LIT. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: THE OGAS
spheres.kicker: the internet the USSR did not build
spheres.blurb: OGAS (Glushkov, 1962), the Soviet dream of a nationwide computer network to run the planned economy in real time, runnable in THE OCHO: a proportional feedback loop settling the plan error (x_{n+1} = x_n + k(target - x_n), converging iff 0 < k < 2) and the hierarchical network (~200 main + ~20,000 local centres). Approved in principle, never built - the internet the USSR did not make. Ties GOBERNET and the calculation debate. Tamper-provable by pushing the gain past 2.

spheres.title: THE TRANSPORTATION PROBLEM
spheres.kicker: Kantorovich's optimal transport, and its dual
spheres.blurb: L. V. Kantorovich's optimal transport (1939; Nobel 1975), runnable in THE OCHO: the assignment problem solved by brute force over all permutations, with Kantorovich duality (potentials u_i + v_j <= C_ij, max dual = min primal) proving the optimum. From the 1939 plywood-trust problem to the Monge-Kantorovich theory and the Wasserstein distance; the real math of central planning. Ties GOBERNET. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: CHEKHOV'S GUN
spheres.kicker: narrative economy, made checkable
spheres.blurb: Chekhov's principle of narrative economy (from his letters, c.1889), runnable in THE OCHO: a story is a list of plants and firings, well-formed iff every planted gun fires and nothing fires unplanted (a time-respecting bijection). A dangling gun or a deus ex machina is flagged. Russian narrative economy as a computable checker, beside Propp. Tamper-provable by allowing dangling guns.

spheres.title: KAISSA
spheres.kicker: the first world computer chess champion, 1974
spheres.source: Kaissa, Institute of Control Sciences, Moscow (1974)
spheres.blurb: Kaissa, the Soviet chess program that won the first World Computer Chess Championship (Stockholm, 1974), runnable in THE OCHO: minimax and alpha-beta on a game tree - alpha-beta returns the identical value while pruning provably-irrelevant branches, so its best case visits about b^(d/2) leaves instead of b^d and searches twice as deep (chess branching ~35). The line to Deep Blue and AlphaZero. Tamper-provable when an unsound cut changes the value.

spheres.title: THE FOX EXPERIMENT
spheres.kicker: selecting for tameness, and the domestication syndrome
spheres.blurb: Dmitri Belyaev's silver-fox experiment (Novosibirsk, from 1959), runnable in THE OCHO: selecting only for tameness produced the domestication syndrome (floppy ears, curled tails) within ~10 generations, modelled by the breeder's equation R = h^2 S - and with heritability h^2 = 0 nothing responds, the quiet refutation of Lysenko. Real genetics run under a hostile regime; ties the-lysenko-affair. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: THE POTEMKIN VILLAGE
spheres.kicker: the facade, and the report that carries zero bits
spheres.blurb: The Potemkin village (1787) and Soviet pripiski, runnable in THE OCHO: reported output pinned to the target while the real falls short, the accumulated gap growing until the shelves are empty - and, information-theoretically, a report that always says 'target met' carries zero bits (entropy 0), so it cannot tell success from failure. The facade made mechanical; ties GOBERNET, OGAS, and the OCHO's own fail-loud law. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: THE MAXIMUM PRINCIPLE
spheres.kicker: time-optimal control is bang-bang
spheres.source: L. S. Pontryagin, The Mathematical Theory of Optimal Processes (1961)
spheres.blurb: Pontryagin's maximum principle (1961), runnable in THE OCHO: the time-optimal control of the double integrator is BANG-BANG - u = +/-1 with a single switch on the curve x1 = -x2|x2|/2. The engine integrates it: from (1,0) the origin is reached in minimum time T=2, and no sub-maximal control is faster. From Pontryagin (blinded at 14) to Bellman and modern optimal control. Tamper-provable by exceeding the actuator bound.

spheres.title: DEAD SOULS
spheres.kicker: the census-lag arbitrage, made mechanical
spheres.blurb: Gogol's Dead Souls (1842), runnable in THE OCHO: Chichikov's census arbitrage made mechanical - dead serfs stay on the tax rolls between censuses, so he buys them for nothing and mortgages them to the state bank, which lends per soul ON THE CENSUS, not per living serf. The arbitrage is the census lag (paper != real); switch the collateral to reality and it collapses. Ties the-potemkin-village. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: THE WATER INTEGRATOR
spheres.kicker: a computer made of water
spheres.source: V. S. Lukyanov, the hydraulic integrator (1936)
spheres.blurb: Lukyanov's hydraulic integrator (1936), runnable in THE OCHO: a computer made of water, where the level is temperature and the flow is heat - solving the heat equation u_t = D u_xx by the explicit FTCS scheme u_i += r(u_{i-1} - 2 u_i + u_{i+1}). It converges to the analytic solution when r <= 1/2 and blows up above it, the physical stability limit the real water respected. Analog computing and its exact digital heir. Tamper-provable at r > 1/2.

spheres.title: THE KOLA BOREHOLE
spheres.kicker: the deepest hole; the gradient and the hoax
spheres.blurb: The Kola Superdeep Borehole (1970-1992), the deepest hole at 12,262 m, rendered honestly in THE OCHO: the geothermal gradient T(z) = T0 + g z, with Kola hitting ~180C at 12 km - about double the prediction, which is why they stopped (the rock turned plastic). Real findings (no basalt layer, water and microfossils deep) LIT; the 'well to hell' screaming-souls audio a re-dubbed hoax, DEAD. A myth measured, like Dyatlov. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: SAMIZDAT
spheres.kicker: banned truth as a branching process
spheres.blurb: Samizdat, the Soviet underground copying of banned texts, runnable in THE OCHO: the diffusion of truth as a branching process - each reader a printing press making k copies, reach k^g, and a sharp threshold (supercritical iff k>1, else it dies out with probability 1; Poisson extinction q = e^{k(q-1)}). The inverse of pripiski: the citizens' true signal spreads while the state's constant 'met' carries zero bits. Ties the-potemkin-village. Tamper-provable at k <= 1.

spheres.title: THE ARNOLD CAT MAP
spheres.kicker: chaos that exactly returns
spheres.source: V. I. Arnold, the cat map (Arnold & Avez, 1968)
spheres.blurb: Vladimir Arnold's cat map, runnable in THE OCHO: the toral automorphism (x,y)->(2x+y,x+y) mod 1, area-preserving (det=1) and chaotic (eigenvalue phi^2, exponential stretching) - yet on an N x N pixel grid it is a permutation with a finite PERIOD, so the scrambled image EXACTLY returns (Poincare recurrence, discretised). Chaos and recurrence at once; the line to KAM theory. Tamper-provable by breaking det=1.

spheres.title: THE MASTER AND MARGARITA
spheres.kicker: manuscripts don't burn, above the threshold
spheres.source: Mikhail Bulgakov, The Master and Margarita (1966-67)
spheres.blurb: Bulgakov's The Master and Margarita ('manuscripts don't burn'), runnable in THE OCHO: the theme made mechanical as a (k,n) threshold code - a manuscript encoded in n shares over a prime field survives if any k copies remain, and is lost below k. Burn up to n-k and it comes back; burn more and it is truly gone. The honest limit of 'manuscripts don't burn'; ties samizdat (truth survives if enough copies were made). Tamper-provable by recovering below the threshold.

spheres.title: THE TOKAMAK
spheres.kicker: Soviet fusion; the Lawson triple product
spheres.blurb: The tokamak (Tamm & Sakharov, early 1950s; ITER is one), runnable in THE OCHO: magnetic-confinement fusion and the Lawson criterion - ignition needs the triple product n T tau above ~3e21 keV s/m^3 near 15 keV, because the fusion power (scaling as n^2) must beat the losses. Compute n T tau and see which plasmas ignite. Soviet-invented, still the leading fusion approach. Tamper-provable at ignition below threshold.

spheres.title: BALL LIGHTNING
spheres.kicker: the honest unsolved one
spheres.blurb: Ball lightning and Kapitsa's 1955 microwave hypothesis, rendered honestly in THE OCHO as the WEIRD room's genuinely UNSOLVED mystery: a ~10-30 cm glowing sphere lasts SECONDS, but a hot plasma would cool in MILLISECONDS - an order-of-magnitude mismatch (~1000x) that rules out simple hot air and leaves no accepted mechanism. Unlike Tunguska, Dyatlov, and Kola (all resolved), this one stays OPEN. Tamper-provable against 'just hot plasma'.

spheres.title: THE RATCHET EFFECT
spheres.kicker: the plan that suppresses the output it chases
spheres.source: Berliner; Weitzman (1980), the Soviet planning ratchet
spheres.blurb: The Soviet planning ratchet (Berliner; Weitzman 1980), runnable in THE OCHO: when next period's target rises with this period's output (target2 = base + alpha output1), a manager optimally WITHHOLDS - revealing capacity only raises tomorrow's quota, so the ratchet suppresses the very output it chases and total output falls. The pathology behind taut plans, slack-hoarding, and pripiski; ties gobernet and the-potemkin-village. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: THE PONTRYAGIN MAXIMUM PRINCIPLE
spheres.kicker: optimal control is bang-bang
spheres.source: Pontryagin, Boltyanskii, Gamkrelidze & Mishchenko, The Mathematical Theory of Optimal Processes (1961)
spheres.blurb: Pontryagin's Maximum Principle (Lev Pontryagin, blind from 14; announced 1956), runnable in THE OCHO on the minimum-time double integrator: the Hamiltonian H=1+p_x v+p_v u, costate p_x'=0 and p_v'=-p_x so p_v is affine, and maximizing H over |u|<=1 forces u*=-sign(p_v) - BANG-BANG control with at most one switch, switching curve x=-0.5 v|v|, min time T*=2 sqrt|x0|. Tamper-provable: an interior control is never time-optimal because H is linear in u.

spheres.title: NOTES FROM UNDERGROUND
spheres.kicker: caprice is not a function
spheres.blurb: Dostoevsky's Notes from Underground (1864) against rational egoism's 'piano key', runnable in THE OCHO as function vs non-function: the rational egoist is a total function State->Action (one state, one forced act), but the Underground Man's caprice maps the SAME state to two actions - advantageous and spiteful - so it is formally NOT a function and cannot be reduced to any deterministic utility table. The philosophy is AMBER; the narrow fact (a one-to-two map is not a function) is LIT. Ties zamyatin-we. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: KOLMOGOROV COMPLEXITY
spheres.kicker: most strings are incompressible
spheres.source: A. N. Kolmogorov, Three approaches to the quantitative definition of information (1965)
spheres.blurb: Kolmogorov complexity K(x) = the shortest program that outputs x (Kolmogorov 1965; also Solomonoff, Chaitin), runnable in THE OCHO: there are 2^n strings of length n but only 2^n-1 shorter programs, so by counting MOST n-bit strings are incompressible (fraction compressible by c bits < 2^(1-c)); a real compressor is only an upper bound (RLE shrinks a periodic string, not a random one); and K itself is UNCOMPUTABLE (a WALL). Tamper-provable: no lossless coder shrinks every input (pigeonhole). Ties keeper Kolmogorov.

spheres.title: THE YAMAL CRATERS
spheres.kicker: the explained one (a gas blowout)
spheres.source: The Yamal gas-emission craters, West Siberia (GEC-1 found 2014)
spheres.blurb: The Yamal Peninsula craters (first found 2014), rendered in THE OCHO as the WEIRD room's EXPLAINED mystery (the mirror of ball-lightning's OPEN): a deep shaft ringed by ejected frozen blocks with a rim methane spike, modelled as a pressure blowout - gas from dissociating hydrates and cryopegs builds beneath a frozen cap until P_gas >= P_atm + rho g h + sigma_t and the cap ruptures. The pressure-threshold physics is LIT (field numbers AMBER); the meteor/impact origin is DEAD. Tamper-provable: an impact leaves shock ejecta, not radial frozen blocks.

spheres.title: THE SOFT BUDGET CONSTRAINT
spheres.kicker: bail out losers, manufacture shortage
spheres.source: Janos Kornai, Economics of Shortage (1980); 'The Soft Budget Constraint' (1986)
spheres.blurb: Kornai's soft budget constraint, runnable in THE OCHO: under a HARD budget a loss-making firm exits, so survivors are efficient and demand stays within supply; under a SOFT budget the state bails everyone (subsidy = sum of deficits > 0), inefficient firms persist, average efficiency falls, and because no one fears loss aggregate input demand exceeds supply - a chronic SHORTAGE. The soft constraint funds losers and manufactures the shortage it meant to relieve. Ties gobernet and the-ratchet-effect. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: THE CENTRAL LIMIT THEOREM
spheres.kicker: why so many things are bell-shaped
spheres.source: A. M. Lyapunov, the CLT under the Lyapunov condition (1901)
spheres.blurb: Lyapunov's Central Limit Theorem (1901), completing the Chebyshev-Markov line, runnable in THE OCHO by EXACT discrete convolution: sum n independent copies of a base distribution (convolve its pmf n times), normalize by sqrt(n sigma^2), and watch the shape approach the standard normal - excess kurtosis -> 0, the base shape forgotten. Mean 0, variance 1 by construction; the limit is universal. Tamper-provable: normalize by n instead of sqrt(n) and it collapses to a spike, not a bell.

spheres.title: BAKHTIN AND DIALOGISM
spheres.kicker: the many-voiced novel
spheres.source: Mikhail Bakhtin, Problems of Dostoevsky's Poetics (1929; expanded 1963)
spheres.blurb: Bakhtin's polyphonic novel (Problems of Dostoevsky's Poetics, 1929/1963), runnable in THE OCHO: a scene modelled as voices + stances + who-addresses-whom, with polyphony = (>=2 distinct UNMERGED voice-stances) AND (none reducible to the author) AND (the address graph is not a star). A Karamazov-like scene is polyphonic; a didactic tract monologizes. The literary theory is AMBER; the partition-and-graph structure is LIT. Bakhtin theorized keeper Dostoevsky himself. Tamper-provable.

spheres.title: THE MIR COMPUTER
spheres.kicker: symbolic math in the 1960s
spheres.source: Glushkov's Institute of Cybernetics, Kyiv - MIR-1 (1965), MIR-2 (1969)
spheres.blurb: Glushkov's MIR (Kyiv; MIR-1 1965, MIR-2 1969), a machine with a high-level language (Analitik) and SYMBOLIC computation, runnable in THE OCHO as an exact symbolic differentiator: parse an expression tree and apply the power/sum/PRODUCT rules to return the exact derivative, verified coefficient-for-coefficient and against a central finite difference. A numeric machine only approximates; the MIR did analytic mathematics in the 1960s. Ties Glushkov and OGAS. Tamper-provable: break the product rule to u'v' and the check fails.

spheres.title: THE KOLA SUPERDEEP BOREHOLE
spheres.kicker: debunk the hoax, keep the science
spheres.blurb: The Kola Superdeep Borehole (1970-1992), 12,262 m - the deepest artificial point on Earth - rendered in THE OCHO as a debunk-the-hoax, keep-the-science sphere: the 'Well to Hell' recording of screams is a documented HOAX (DEAD), but the real results are stranger - about 180 C at the bottom (far above the extrapolated ~100 C) and free water at depth, while the hole is only 0.19% of Earth's radius, nowhere near the mantle. The thermal/hydrological physics is LIT. Tamper-provable: the depth cannot reach the mantle.

spheres.title: THE NOMENKLATURA
spheres.kicker: loyalty over competence, and the decay
spheres.blurb: The nomenklatura - the Party's list of key posts filled by LOYALTY over competence - runnable in THE OCHO as adverse selection: with a fixed candidate pool, the mean competence of the loyalty-selected set is strictly below the merit-selected set (and below the pool average when loyalty anti-correlates with competence), and iterating (loyal cohorts pick loyal successors) ratchets average competence down. Ties gobernet, the-ratchet-effect, the-soft-budget-constraint. Tamper-provable: selecting for loyalty forfeits competence.
